rationale: Reconnect deterministic evaluation to the current guarded response path by adapting already-produced canonical StageResult objects and the released response artifact into the existing immutable evaluation capture and assertion machinery. The legacy private PipelineRunner is not used by the active FINAL_EVALUATION path.
supersession_impact: No capability is superseded. The historical injected runner remains compatibility-only inside the same evaluation capability, while canonical capture becomes the active final-evaluation entry.
authority_impact: Evaluation gains no insurance semantic authority. It may only score captured execution and response artifacts. It cannot re-run stages, retrieve evidence, reason, alter response content, or broaden recommendation authority; non-PASS evaluation fails closed.
